name: OneDev
summary: OneDev is a self-hosted Git server with pull requests, code review policies and role-based project permissions. The Community Edition is free. Enterprise costs $6 per user a month with a minimum of 12 user months per order. The pages checked show no hosted option.

facts.text: The quickstart creates a project in the web interface and pushes to it with a normal Git remote. OneDev runs in Docker or on bare metal.
OneDev has pull requests for work submission and code review, and code review policies can require specific reviewers when certain files change.
A role defines a set of permissions, and a role must be chosen when a project is granted to a user or group.
Enterprise orders have a minimum of 12 user months, and disabled users, service accounts and AI users are excluded from the license count.
Community Edition support runs through the issue tracker, while Enterprise lists priority email support with a response within two business days.

plans.name: Community Edition
plans.notes: Listed as Free, with community support through the issue tracker and no guaranteed response time

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Minimum of 12 user months per order. A Try Free button is offered; the page does not state its length. No currency is named

hiddenCosts: Each Enterprise order has a minimum of 12 user months.
The pages checked describe self-hosting only, so server and upkeep costs fall on the buyer.
